How I Work

A Clear Path from Audit to Verified Data.

Browser vs Server-side

The Same Traffic, Tracked Two Different Ways.

What to checkBrowser onlyServer-side (after setup)
Blocked by ad blockersOften lostMuch less affected
Cookie lifetimeLimited by browser rulesSet on your own domain
Duplicate handlingEasy to double countDeduplicated with event ID
Data ownershipSpread across toolsStored in your own container

A general comparison, not a promise of specific results.

UTM Link Builder

Add campaign tags to any URL so your analytics can tell where the traffic came from.

Quick Tracking Checklist

Eight checks you can run in about ten minutes on any site.

  • Purchase event fires once per order
  • Order ID matches your store's order number
  • Purchase value and currency are correct
  • Ad platform conversions are close to real orders
  • Form submissions appear in your CRM
  • Browser and server events share an event ID
  • UTM parameters survive checkout
  • Consent banner respected before tags fire

Projects Across Platforms and Websites.

Consent Mode v2 · Cookiebot

Consent-aware Tracking for an Ecommerce Store

Overview

An ecommerce site that wanted to give visitors control over cookies, with tracking that follows each choice.

The problem

Tracking ran the same way for every visitor, whatever cookie choices they had made.

What I solved

Set up Cookiebot as the consent banner, connected it to Google Tag Manager, and configured the default and updated consent states.

Outcome

The consent setup follows each visitor's choice, and the full flow was tested in GTM Preview.

Tools used
Google Tag ManagerConsent Mode v2Cookiebot
GA4 · Ecommerce

Seeing the Shopping Journey in GA4

Overview

An online store that needed a clear view of its products, its ads and its purchase path.

The problem

They could not see what customers did, which products performed, or which step of the funnel was losing people.

What I solved

Built GA4 ecommerce tags in Tag Manager for the main events, each with its own trigger, and connected GA4 to GTM.

Outcome

Ecommerce events, from product views through to purchase, are captured in GA4 with their item details.

Tools used
GA4Google Tag ManagerGA4 DebugView
Google Ads · Enhanced Conversions

Conversions and Remarketing from One Container

Overview

A client who wanted accurate conversion data and remarketing for their Google Ads campaigns.

The problem

Key actions were not measured reliably, and product interest was not being used for remarketing.

What I solved

Created Enhanced Conversion tags, conversion tags for key actions, and dynamic remarketing tags for product views, all in one container.

Outcome

Purchase, add to cart, begin checkout and lead form conversion actions are active, and the purchase tag fired with transaction data.

Tools used
Google Tag ManagerGoogle AdsTag AssistantData layer
JotForm · Google Ads

Counting Every JotForm Enquiry Once

Overview

A lead generation site that takes its enquiries through JotForm.

The problem

JotForm submissions were not being counted as Google Ads conversions.

What I solved

Built the submission trigger, a Google Ads Conversion Tracking tag, and a User-Provided Data tag for Enhanced Conversions in GTM, then checked them in Preview.

Outcome

Form submissions count as Google Ads conversions, with the user-provided data passed through Enhanced Conversions.

Tools used
JotFormGoogle Tag ManagerGoogle AdsEnhanced ConversionsGTM Preview
Meta Pixel & Conversions API

Purchases Meta Can Actually Match

Overview

A client who wanted reliable conversion data from Meta for their ads.

The problem

Browser events alone were missing some purchases, and the same order could be counted twice.

What I solved

Built the pixel and Conversions API tags in Tag Manager, added event IDs for deduplication, and checked the parameters in Events Manager.

Outcome

Purchase event match quality reached 8.0/10 in Events Manager, with browser and server events deduplicated.

Meta Events ManagerGoogle Tag ManagerGA4Stape serverMeta Pixel Helper

Contact Form 7 · WordPress

Enquiries That Show Up in GA4 and Google Ads

Overview

A WordPress service business that takes enquiries through Contact Form 7.

The problem

Successful enquiries were not counted, so the ads looked like they were getting no leads.

Your Data Is Only as Accurate as Your Tracking Setup.

When your reports stop matching your sales, the cause is almost always in the setup, not the ads.

Hi, I'm Lipi Khatun, a web analytics and conversion tracking specialist.

I have worked as a freelance tracking specialist on Upwork and Fiverr, and directly with online stores and lead generation businesses.

I work across WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Wix, and custom JavaScript and Laravel sites. My tools include GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Microsoft Ads and server-side tracking, along with form, booking and offline conversions.

My focus is simple: tracking that is built properly and tested before handover, so the numbers you decide on can be trusted.

FAQ

Common Questions.

Will This Work with My Website or Store?

Usually yes. The setup depends on your platform, such as Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress or a custom site. The free audit confirms the right approach.

Do You Need Access to My Ad Accounts?

Only the access the tracking work needs, such as Google Tag Manager, GA4 and the relevant ad platform. You keep ownership of your accounts.

How Do You Check That the Tracking Is Accurate?

I test each event in GTM Preview and GA4 DebugView, then compare the results with your orders or CRM records before I hand the setup over.

How Long Does a Project Take?

It depends on how many platforms are involved. I will give you a timeline after the audit.

Is the Free Audit Really Free?

Yes. We review your current tracking together and you get a written list of fixes. You are not obliged to hire me.

Do You Provide Support After the Tracking Is Delivered?

Yes. After handover I stay available to answer questions about the setup and help if something changes on your site or in your ad accounts. For ongoing review, reporting and fixes over time, the Monthly Check package covers that work in full.

How Do I Get Started?

Send me a message on WhatsApp or by email with your website and the ad platforms you use. I'll reply with the next steps.
